# Chess Parfait

> Chess Parfait (chessparfait.com) is the chess coaching website of FIDE Master Luis Chan, based in Glen Waverley, Victoria (Melbourne, Australia). Luis offers private chess lessons as home visits in and around Glen Waverley, chess coaching for schools, and online lessons, for complete beginners through to competitive tournament players. The site also has free chess training tools: weekly puzzles, endgame practice, strategy guides and chess mini-games.

## Chess coaching

- [Chess coaching in Glen Waverley & Melbourne](https://chessparfait.com/chess-coaching-melbourne): lesson formats (home visits, schools, online), what lessons cover, student and parent reviews, and FAQs.
- [Contact / book a lesson](https://chessparfait.com/contact): enquiry form for lessons, school programs and online coaching. Email: luischanchess@gmail.com
- [About FM Luis Chan](https://chessparfait.com/about): background and coaching experience.

## About the coach

- FIDE Master (title awarded 2018), FIDE rating 2280, ACF rating 2318.
- Over 7 years of coaching experience; students have reached 2000+ FIDE ratings.
- Board 1 for the University of Melbourne at the 2026 FIDE World University Team Chess Championship.
- Represented Australia at the 2021 FIDE Online Olympiad.
- Australian Schools Teams Champion in 2014, 2015, 2016, 2019 and 2020.
- Winner of the 2024 Chess.com Fog of War Chess Championship: https://www.chess.com/news/view/2024-chesscom-fog-of-war-chess-championship-knockout-chan-wins
- FIDE profile: https://ratings.fide.com/profile/3216357
- Chess.com profile: https://www.chess.com/member/luizzy
